name: efatura
description: Descarga multiempresa das faturas do e-Fatura pelo webservice de consulta da AT

scripts.build: prisma generate && next build && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --packages=external --outfile=dist/server.js --tsconfig=tsconfig.json && esbuild prisma/seed.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --packages=external --outfile=dist/seed.js && esbuild scripts/migrate.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --packages=external --outfile=dist/migrate.js
